text:
Marie Chen: Heads-up: planning a soft launch for SDK v17 tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need quick ops sync: who's on deploy, smoke owners, and rollback ready? cc @akshay @sarah
Akshay Patel: I can own the deploy window and monitor metrics. Can we make window 10:00-11:00 PT? Prefer low traffic.
Sarah O'Neill: I'll run smoke tests + client compatibility checks. Preparing prompt set and sample clients.
John Park: I'm on rollback duty. Plan: proxy toggle to v16 bundle; full rollback target 2m. Need deploy flags in the release manifest.
Elin Torres: I'll handle client comms — draft changelog: "v17: minor surface additions, backward-compatible by default; opt-in headers for new features." Will post 30m before.
Deploy Bot: deploy scheduled: staging -> canary -> prod. Notifying owners.
Marie Chen: Can we do canary ramp: 10:05 (5%) -> 10:15 (50%) -> 10:30 (100%)? Need metrics: p50/p95 latency, token cost.
Akshay Patel: Yes. Ramp script in place. Smoke commands:
```
# smoke command
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDK_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","input":"test"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Sarah O'Neill: Running those now. Target checks: success >=2/3 models, p95 < 300ms, no 5xx.
John Park: Rollback steps (if needed): `admin routing set-version api redwood-sdk v16` then abort rollout. I can run this.
Elin Torres: Sending heads-up to client-ops 1h before, changelog at 30m. Any breaking changes? @Akshay
Akshay Patel: No breaking changes. Added optional response fields and extra header support but default behavior unchanged. Added compatibility tests to CI.
Marie Chen: Action items: @Akshay deploy & metrics, @Sarah smoke + post results, @John rollback standby, @Elin client comms. Reply 'ok' if clear.
Akshay Patel: ok
Sarah O'Neill: ok, running smoke now
John Park: ok standby
Elin Torres: ok drafting comms
Marie Chen: :thumbsup: I'll validate pre-deploy checklist at 09:45 PT.
Deploy Bot: Canary started 10:05 PT — 5% traffic. https://deploys.redwood/status/1968765432
Sarah O'Neill: Smoke results: all good. p50 180ms, p95 260ms, schema validation passed, no 5xx.
Akshay Patel: Canary -> 50% at 10:15 done. Observability: token cost +3% for longer responses.
Marie Chen: Proceed to 100% at 10:30.
Deploy Bot: Rollout complete 10:33 PT. Details: https://deploys.redwood/1968765432
Elin Torres: Comms sent to client-ops and changelog published: https://www.redwood.ai/changelog/v17
John Park: No rollback needed. Marking as done. I'll monitor for 2h.
Marie Chen: Thanks all — closing thread. If any regression, reopen and notify #incidents.
